name: Proper Labeled Sample Compression of Full Cube
proof: Proper unlabeled compression is a restriction of proper labeled compression, so the latter is at least its established full-cube value $n$. The established effective-range upper bound gives $\mathrm{pLSC}\leq\mathrm E$, and the full cube has effective range $n$. Thus $\mathrm{pLSC}=n$.
